title: Wynn Las Vegas — Overview and history
body: Public edition. Public records, fact-checked reference. Wynn Las Vegas is a luxury resort and casino on the Las Vegas Strip, opened on April 28, 2005, by Steve Wynn. Its sister tower, Encore at Wynn, opened in 2008. The combined complex holds about 4,750 rooms and is known for high-end design, the Lake of Dreams multimedia show, and award-winning dining. It consistently ranks among the top-rated hotels in Las Vegas.

title: Wynn Las Vegas — Notable milestones and public record
body: Public edition. Public records, fact-checked reference.
